_comment: AI Video Generator 1.1 — MANUAL MODE Preset Template
_instructions: This preset uses 'manual' mode: YOU write the scene concepts
and GLM-4.7 enhances them into production-ready video prompts.
HOW TO USE:
1. Copy this file:  copy manual_example.json my_scenes.json
2. Replace 'user_prompts' with your own scene descriptions
3. Run:  python utils/video_gen.py --preset presets/my_scenes.json
WHAT TO CHANGE:
• user_prompts — list of scene descriptions (one per video)
Write a short description of what you want to see.
GLM will enhance each into a detailed, cinematic prompt.
Number of videos = number of prompts (1:1 mapping).
• model — video backend: kling, veo3, sora-kie, sora, or sora-pro
• style / mood / aspect / duration / mode / sound — see auto_example.json
• image_urls — list of image lists, one inner list per scene.
Each inner list holds one or more reference images for that scene.
Use [] for text-to-video (no image). Examples:
One image per scene:
[["images/scene1.jpg"], ["images/scene2.jpg"]]
Multiple images for scene 1, none for scene 2:
[["images/a.jpg", "images/b.jpg"], []]
Mix of local paths and URLs:
[["images/a.jpg", "https://example.com/ref.jpg"], []]
Paths are relative to the project root folder.
The image(s) become the reference and the AI animates from them.
TIP: Set 'research' to search the web for background info.
e.g. 'solar farm technology photovoltaic efficiency'
GLM will use the facts to make prompts more accurate.
user_prompts: A massive solar farm stretching across a desert, panels gleaming under golden hour light, with a slow drone flyover revealing the scale
